name: [🎃+ NEW MAP!] Yard Rescue Crew
desc:
NEW MAP + HALLOWEEN - 10/30/2026

🌳 NEW MAP: The Fallen Oak. Sprawlco wants the whole neighborhood. Save the Hales' yard first! Finish the garden once to unlock it.
🎃 Halloween, until Nov 7: visit the ghost's shop and trick-or-treat at lit porches on Maple Lane.
⭐ NEW: Levels! Every job earns XP toward your crew level.

Mow, trim, pressure wash and bring forgotten yards back to life, solo or with up to 3 friends! 🌿

🧰 Mower, trimmer, pressure washer, ride-on, axe, jackhammer, roller and more
⬆️ Earn cash and upgrade your tools
🔍 Collect hidden Finds, plus a secret
🏆 Earn titles and top the Best Times boards
🎨 Customize your tools and mow patterns into the lawn
🎵 Chill lo-fi music while you work

Meet your crew on Maple Lane and set up a job at the pads. Join our community at the mailbox for a free gift!

I work on the game a crazy amount every day and I'm gonna be doing this for a long time!  It will get better!

Tags: grass, cut grass, cleaning, co-op, power washing, yard work

llm.loop: take yard jobs at the pads -> mow, trim, pressure wash and restore overgrown yards solo or with friends -> earn cash and XP -> upgrade and customize tools -> unlock new maps
llm.objectives: bring forgotten yards back to life and save the neighborhood from Sprawlco
llm.progression: cash, tool upgrades, crew level XP, new maps, titles, hidden finds
llm.instructions: set up a job at the pads, mow/trim/pressure wash yards solo or with up to 3 friends, earn cash, upgrade tools, collect hidden finds
unique: PowerWash Simulator-style yard restoration with story framing, mow patterns and lo-fi vibe
llm.thumbnails: pumpkin ride-on mower, NEW MAP! The Fallen Oak, crew mowing tall grass, before/after split of an overgrown vs clean yard
